如果是几年前对这个游戏的demo版本进行评测，我估计会毫不犹豫的打出好评，但是在吸血鬼幸存者横扫独立游戏的现在，这款游戏就显得无趣了。 这几年来，游戏真正称得上重大的更新寥寥无几，最新的改动只是添加了更丰富的敌人以及游戏模式。对于游戏性的修改几乎没有，可以明显的感受到制作组有点产能不足了。 说到底，这款游戏最根本的问题在于他几乎无法提供完整的正反馈，整个游戏的核心模式是一个无尽闯关，这就导致无论是什么组合，都会有强度更不上波次的时候。哪怕在狂野模式中可以选择相同的模块，升级需要经验的增加也会让你感到自己一定会在未来失败。这种底层设计导致玩家很难在长时间的游玩中获得爽快的体验，刷新自己的分数带来的快乐我个人认为是不如通关一个有关底boss的限时关卡的。 同时，游戏的build也没有真正意义上的随机性。往往是想好要走那条流派再开始游戏，而不是在游戏中完善自己的流派。这使得局内成长很难让人有惊喜感，超级模块在初见时确实很有趣，但理解游戏后却变成了必须要完成的任务一样无聊。 最后是地图与敌人的设计，这个边界互通的地图确实是游戏的特色，但是这个特点在游戏性上却只与穿梭弹一个超级模块有所联动（或许撞击流也算？），实在是很可惜。而对游戏敌人的设计却完全是负面作用，事实上，如果采用类幸存者的大型地图，感觉敌人完全可以有更丰富的变种以及数量。现在游戏内的弹幕以及敌人数量往往会限制的非常少，数量较多的弹幕伤害也很低（高层数伤害高主要是自生成长慢导致）。正是因为地图太小了，哪怕是熟练贴边，也会有很多攻击无法躲避。战场上敌人少了，自己杀的也不够爽快。 综上所述，游戏提供的正反馈实在太少。局内敌人太少，成长更像任务而非奖励，成型后立刻就感受到获取经验的速度开始跟不上敌人的强度。局外只是给出分数，没有获取的货币或者解锁内容。这就导致玩家很难长期投入，真的建议制作组多做点大型的地图（就是把现在的随机环境事件分开到更大的图里，比如小型星带、黑洞、磁场区等等），然后把单局时间搞成20-30分钟的关卡作为主要的游戏模式，再提供一些局外的成长内容丰富游戏。

1.离谱的操作方式： 四向冲刺和四向移动就八个按键了还有一堆按键没绑定想不通怎么用键盘才能玩的舒服？大道至简我选择只用鼠标移动和射击，但是这飞船吧是真的难开，我是根本不敢点移速和冲刺能力。 2.贫瘠的局内选择： 有些移动模块属实抽象。移速越高造成伤害越高，大部分武器快起来根本打不中，更别说飞船操作本来就很难，等会一头撞boss身上自己得掉半条命，而且最安全的走位是躲屏幕边缘切屏，所以我一局基本上都不拿移动模块，不如增加输出和生存能力。 持续移动越久范围灼烧伤害越高，持续射击加射速，蓄力。以上能力都会自残，还有一个输出能力提高（具体效果略）但子弹数量越多，自残越狠，制作组你敢拿满自残模块打一局高难吗？还有一堆数值给的抠抠搜搜的有负面的模块我都懒得骂了。 伤害模块只有跟踪，多重，爆炸和射速，远程就一个狙击模块（越远伤害越高）。导致所有武器近到光剑，远到轨道炮，基本上都要变成喷子。那你为什么不拿别的模块呢？移动不拿，自残不拿，多重不拿，有些武器拿爆炸也没用，这游戏高难boss强度提升巨大，小怪也不是很强，什么杀敌加射速，敌人死亡爆炸也不用拿，那我拿啥？炮塔，无人机脆的和纸一样，堆肉打boss又纯刮痧，而且还是有被boss秒的风险。每局游戏大同小异，我打一局高难好不容易解锁的高级模块，也个顶个的抽象。实在想不通好评为什么能玩300+h？ 对了有一些改变射击角度的模块，数值也没有高到可以扶大厦之将倾的地步，加上武器基本上都要变喷子贴脸打输出，射击角度一改打精英怪我都不会走位了，分分钟暴毙（不是说懒得骂了吗（这个必须提一嘴））。

本来是打算给好评的，但你小子好评太多再给好评提的建议你不放心上，给你个差评警惕警惕。 缺点:1.粪怪。神裔，3个有实体碰撞体积还会扩大轨道半径高速旋转的伴随球，超远射程伤害极高且跟踪能力极强的大激光，如果你没有趁它刚上场时就赶紧搞死它，那接下来在它丢完技能之前你就只有抱头鼠窜的份了。黄色半圆盘子，这是个人感觉最粪的怪，作者本意是想设计一个正面肉背面脆大体积低机动能力的笨重怪，但实际上这个怪转向能力丝毫不弱，本人在构筑时一般不加入巨象这种会减机动性的BUFF，但我想转到它背后总是十分费劲，它的转向能力可以说也就仅仅差我绕后速度一点点，好不容易转到背后了它一喷火直接来一段高速位移加一片极高伤害的火幕，没撵上屁股跟输出事小，要是你本来血就不健康那一个不注意给你直接摁死才叫逆天。蓝色大翅膀鸟，自身本来体积就大还好乱转机动性还高，还会放存在时间较长的超大能量漩涡，这BOSS一出来整片屏幕它要占三分之一到一半，机动空间受极大限制。装甲钉刺头，你要是不玩撞击类流派那其实这怪也还好，但如果你要玩撞击流这怪直接给你喂粪喂到饱，如果你没有趁他没攻击的时候速度弄死它，你就会发现这怪几乎无从下手，正面免伤高撞不动还带伤害，背面丢导弹丢能量球伤害极高。 2.护盾机制几乎无用。到了后期敌人出现速度越来越快数量也越来越多，吃一些小伤害是经常的，但这游戏的护盾是要求一段较长时间完全不受击然后一次性给你护盾回满，这护盾回复的意义何在？那个取消护盾增加血量的BUFF几乎成了我每局标配，那些专门为护盾设计的部件也一直用不上 3.可玩的构筑流派看似很多其实很少。游戏越后期堆怪越多，那些轨道炮榴弹毒弹炽光乱七八糟的东西清怪能力根本跟不上敌人的刷新速度，真正强力的武器和机体也就那么几个。并且确定你一整把战斗风格的就这两个东西武器和机体，后续的各种BUFF基本都是数值上的加成很少有能够对你整体战斗风格产生较大改变的BUFF了。

Ah, Nova Drift.. A great game, with great potential, and one that actually offered me a lot of fun. It was quite good until 1.0 came out to be perfectly honest here, and there's a reason for which I actually have whole 11 hours in the game, at the time of writing this review. Was the steering frustrating but unique? Yes. Were/Are the graphics and general art style absolutely amazing? That too. You also can't the deny just how many great ideas for bosses, enemies, all sorts of equipment like your own weapon, shields and body type there are, and this also includes the extremely wide range and variety of in-game modifications, also called mods that you can take to change how your ship behaves - More than that, there are also wild mods, drastically changing the whole game in many amazing ways, making it nearly completely unpredictable in a very good way, plenty of game modes and ways to have fun, like boss rush, endless mode, and so, soo much more. Really, I actually wanted to keep on playing this one, and I NEVER play roguelikes or roguelites myself, bullet hells I also don't, so this was a very unique and positive experience for me. Why do I still recommend you to STAY AWAY from this game and developer then? Well, that's pretty simple. Like I have said at the beginning of this review, the problem came when 1.0 version was being planned out during development by Chimeric and his incredibly toxic, and close-minded Discord community, fully supportive of, and almost never questioning Chimeric's decisions for the final boss of the game, and then, eventually, actually released later down the road. Chimeric decided to do the worst possible thing here - Close his game off from modding by creating it in GameMaker, and then moving it to GameMaker Studio 2 I believe it was called, making it even harder to modify the game in any way you wanted to, which the community would have had absolutely loved to do for many different reasons - What that was, was just a bunch of excuses from his side, supported by that close-minded, incredibly toxic community of absolute hardcore players, all sitting tight and closed together in one, tiny Discord server, where any sort of valuable insight on why the Star Eater, the current final boss of the game, was a horrible idea and concept right from the beginning. The Star Eater makes the casual player have nothing to look for in this game, as it requires an absurd amount of something that's not even skill, but highly specific builds that invalidate all the other ones in the game, and pure, dumb luck, even with the predictable patterns of movements and attacks, since Star Eater can easily cover the whole screen with it's massive body and also force you to maneuver vertically between it's body parts too. Once again - No amount of critique would get through to Chimeric, the developer, and yes, I am calling you out by name here, if you ever happen to read this, whether you care for this review or not, or regardless of whether you even see it in the first place or not either, and all of it would just be addressed by making the boss take 200% more damage or have people be told that this a "skill issue" if they can't fight the thing, which is a completely nonsensical claim to make - Skill has NOTHING to do with horrible game design, and it can not, and never will be confused with "skill issue" or just the amount of skill a player has in your game. Basically though.. Just stay away, unless you have the patience of a saint to not get frustrated once you get to the end of the game - And don't be surprised if Star Eater shows up more than once in an Endless mode run, because yes, apparently, that was needed too.

You must Nova [i]Drift[/i] while blasting foes and evolving your ship with upgrades to obtain great firepower or create explosive constructs or ram straight through enemies with hulking mass. The movement in this game is unlike I've ever played, you can play with as little as one hand because you can only move forwards (and some alternative moves with upgrades) and rotate your ship while drifting with very little drag. It's a bit off-putting at first, but once you get the hang of it it's very smooth and fun. When you fly off screen, you instead appear from the other side of your screen, use that to your advantage. Overall this is a very fun arcade game, simply blast away at your foes, gather experience, level up and unlock upgrades to enhance yourself and face off against greater foes and bosses all before the final boss and even an endless mode if you enable it before a run! My favourite build is using the leviathan body (giant space snake) and the vortex weapon that while holding down fire, creates a vortex that charges over time to become a huge ball of constant destruction in combination with an upgrade that causes incoming damage to boost your weapon's charge, letting me pretty much create a massive black hole when hugging the enemy to take and deal collision damage.
